reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the rendered redline is identical to the original paragraphs with no comment, which is exactly what is expected for a compliant finding.

The cited text supports the conclusion: §7.3 leaves supply to a future Supply Agreement negotiated in good faith on commercially reasonable terms with no committed volumes, and §8.2 expressly labels Sanofi's sales/marketing forecasts and net sales projections as non-binding — no take-or-pay, shortfall penalty, or volume cap on our party.

The rationale correctly treats event-driven upfront/milestone/royalty payments and budget-capped cost reimbursement as not constituting minimum purchase commitments, and correctly notes the §5.7 Commercially Reasonable Efforts diligence standard as a non-commitment observation rather than a deviation (consistent with the playbook's treatment of minor sub-elements in the rationale).
No deterministic check failures; no over-flagging since no negotiation issue is raised, so the finding is properly retained as internal evidence only.
